name: Farne Azzrael
original_name: ファン・アズラーウェル
source:
Born 05/28/2036
A genius girl who skipped grades. [url=/c45804]Oak's[/url] older twin sister.
Usually a dainty intellectual girl, sometimes she disguises herself as Oak and cheekily performs tricks on people.
